capabilities: upload pictures and videos to the WeChat public account resource management
add drafts and publish articles to the WeChat public platform
download materials from WeChat and videos from YouTube
publish articles to Baidu Baijiahao and view a statistics dashboard
extras: Sending group messages to fans requires authenticated calling permission; the WeChat server requires the client IP to be whitelisted; settings take effect only after the plugin is restarted; the repo also ships an OpenClaw CLI for automation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish articles, images, or videos to the WeChat public platform or Baidu Baijiahao.

relations.evidence: publish articles or videos and other resources in obsidian to the WeChat public account
publish obsidian's article to baidu's baijiahao

requires.name: Tencent WeChat server account with client IP whitelisted

summary: Publishing plugin that sends vault articles and media to WeChat public accounts and Baidu Baijiahao, with material downloads and a stats dashboard.
